ml-1: Salutation to you, Mahamaya, worshipped by the gods at Sri-pitha, holding conch, discus, and mace.
ml-2: Mounted on Garuda, terror to the asura Kola, remover of all sin — salutations.
ml-3: All-knowing, giver of every boon, terror to the wicked, taker of every sorrow.
ml-4: Giver of siddhi and buddhi, of enjoyment and liberation, always the mantra-form.
ml-5: Without beginning or end, primal Shakti, Maheshvari, born of yoga.
ml-6: Gross and subtle, fiercely great, vast-wombed Shakti, remover of great sin.
ml-7: Seated on the lotus, form of the supreme Brahman, mother of the world.
ml-8: White-robed, adorned with many ornaments, abiding in the world as its mother.
